svg.title: Ormesson
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection. Actual color illustration: Else van Sterkenburg-Fransen, Radboud University bachelor thesis (2017), PDF 65 fig 25. Foundation EK 29 installation and MoMA 1973 note 26 independently identify the painting/date. Three white joined panels retain the separate black and green chimney-derived motifs. The thesis reports 83.8×224.2 cm, but those dimensions are kept as secondary evidence only, not promoted to measured primary facts. Observed reproduction aspect retained despite its difference from the secondary dimensional ratio. Panel contours approximated; texture omitted.
